activities.title: Quick check: a memo you've never seen

blocks.prompt: The AI draft cites "Memorandum Order No. 2026-117". You've never seen it. What do you do?
options: Keep it. It makes the letter sound official.
Ask the AI, "Is this memo real?"
Look for it in an official source; delete it if you can't find it.
Change the number slightly so it looks less copied.

activities.title: Lab 2: AI-Assisted Word Processing and Mail Merge
activities.intro: Draft a formal Invitation to the Digital Skills Workshop from the Administrative Section of a sample Revenue District Office with AI help, then check and edit it yourself, format it, add a table and mail merge it to at least 3 colleagues. You may adapt the scenario (a parent-teacher meeting notice, a promo letter to 3 loyal customers, or a barangay or church invitation); the requirements stay the same. Lab 2 is worth 30% of the course grade.

items: Multi-paragraph letter with every fact checked (dates and days on a calendar, names, positions).
No [Insert Name] or other placeholders, and no chat leftovers.
AI help disclosed in one line.
Justified text, standard font sizes and 1-inch margins, with a consistent, readable layout.
An embedded table inside the letter: at least 2 columns × 3 rows, with headers.
Mail merge linked to a separate data source (Name, Position, Section, Email).
At least 3 distinct, personalised letters in one file, and no blank letters.
Only sample or permitted data used, no confidential information, and sources credited.
Merged file named Lab 2 - Lastname - Merged Invitations - 2026-11-xx.docx

blocks.prompt: Paste the prompt you gave the AI (Role, Task, Context, Format, Tone). Sample data only.
Upload your merged file: Lab 2 - Lastname - Merged Invitations - 2026-11-xx.docx
Your main document and spreadsheet, in case the facilitator asks

criteria.name: Content and human editing: multi-paragraph letter, facts checked, no placeholders, AI help disclosed
Formatting: justified text, standard font sizes, 1-inch margins, consistent and readable layout
Embedded table: at least 2 columns × 3 rows, with headers, inside the letter
Mail merge: linked to a separate data source; at least 3 distinct, personalised letters in one file, no blank letters
Responsible AI: only sample or permitted data used; no confidential information; sources credited

help: Sample disclosure: "First draft prepared with an AI assistant; reviewed, fact-checked and edited by Maria Santos."
Save your prompt in a text file at step 2. It helps you write the disclosure.
Do the mail merge last, after the letter is final, so you merge only once.
Before saving, press Ctrl + F and search for [ to catch leftover placeholders.
Type "help" in the chat any time to ask for a screen-share.
